name: Italy
oneLineFragment: Dolomite limestone towers blushing pink at enrosadira.
narrativeStory:
The sheer pinnacles of Tre Cime di Lavaredo and the Odle range rising out of subalpine larch forests. As dusk settles, the pale calcium-magnesium rock catches the last rays of sunlight, igniting into fire and rose before cooling to ash.

Alpine dairy huts (malghe) smell of wood smoke and cowhide, carrying echoes of mountain transhumance.
subtitle: Dolomite Alps • South Tyrol & Trentino
